hero.title: THE JOURNEY
hero.subtitle: A Story of Love, Sacrifice, Dreams, and Family
hero.description: An intimate, cinematic chronicle of a lifelong voyage—from innocent childhood curiosity to standing proud with a Computer Science diploma. A tribute to the two extraordinary parents whose unconditional sacrifices built every single milestone along the way.
hero.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

welcome.title: Welcome, Mom and Dad
welcome.subtitle: Before we begin this journey, I'd like to thank you from the bottom of my heart.
welcome.greeting: Tonight, we are not just looking back at school years or exam scores. We are watching the story of our family—the quiet mornings, the sleepless nights, the sacrifices you never talked about, and the love that guided every step I took.
welcome.quote: “To the world, you may be two people. But to me, you are the entire world that made this diploma possible.”

episodes.title: Episode 1: The Beginning
episodes.subtitle: Birth, Childhood, and First Dreams
episodes.summary: Every great journey starts with quiet love. From my first steps in a warm home to dreaming about what the future holds under starry nights.
fullStory: Before I ever wrote a line of code or sat in a university lecture hall, I was a child wrapped in the safety of your arms. Mom, your gentle touch healed every scrape. Dad, your strong hands made me feel like I could touch the sky whenever you held me high.

Our early home was filled with simple joys. We didn't have luxury, but we had warmth, laughter, and dinner together every single night. You taught me to be curious about how things worked—taking apart small toys, asking endless questions, and dreaming bigger than our small living room.
Looking back at those childhood photos, I realize that my confidence today was forged in those early years. You made me feel safe enough to dream, and loved enough to try.

episodes.title: Episode 2: Growing Up
episodes.subtitle: School Days, Friendships, and Character
episodes.summary: Navigating elementary and high school—discovering passions, forging lifelong friendships, and learning the value of discipline from family guidance.
fullStory: School years brought new challenges: early morning alarm clocks, backpack straps digging into shoulders, science fairs, and math exams. Mom woke up early every single morning to prepare warm meals and make sure my uniform was pressed.
Dad showed me what discipline meant. Even after a 12-hour workday, he would sit down at the kitchen table to help me check my math homework, never showing an ounce of fatigue.

Through high school, when self-doubt started creeping in and peer pressure felt heavy, your moral compass kept me grounded. You taught me that true strength isn't being the loudest in the room, but being the most resilient and kind.

episodes.title: Episode 3: The Hardest Chapter
episodes.subtitle: College, Stress, Financial Struggles & Self-Doubt
episodes.summary: The raw, emotional valley of the journey. Navigating university tuition, brutal exam weeks, late-night breakdowns, and finding hope when giving up felt tempting.
fullStory: University was the hardest test of my life. The workload was relentless, data structures and algorithms felt impossible at times, and financial burdens weighed heavily on our family. I watched how hard Mom and Dad worked to pay for my tuition, sacrificing their own needs so I wouldn't have to drop out.
There were nights when code refused to compile, thesis deadlines loomed, and tears filled my eyes at 3:00 AM. I felt the crushing weight of wanting to make you proud and fearing I might fall short.

In those dark moments, a phone call from home was my lifeline. 'Eat well, don't stress too much, we believe in you.' Those simple words gave me the courage to pick up my laptop and keep pushing forward.

episodes.title: Episode 4: The Programmer
episodes.subtitle: Mastering Code, Building Projects & Finding Purpose
episodes.summary: From printing 'Hello World' in basic HTML to building full-stack web applications, React architectures, and elegant user interfaces.
fullStory: Programming started as a curious hobby—learning HTML tags in a text editor and watching text change color on a screen. But as I mastered JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern UI engineering, it turned into my true craft.
I spent hundreds of weekends building applications, debugging state management issues, creating responsive design systems, and learning how technology can touch human emotions.

This very website is proof of that transformation. Every line of code, every motion curve, every glassmorphic element was crafted with the skills I built over these years—built specifically to honor the two people who made me who I am.

episodes.title: Episode 5: Graduation Day
episodes.subtitle: The Triumphant Summit & Shared Victory
episodes.summary: Walking across the stage in black gown and cap. The culmination of 16+ years of education, culminating in tears of joy, family hugs, and lifelong pride.
fullStory: The morning of Graduation Day arrived under a bright blue sky. Fitting into the black velvet cap and gown felt surreal. Sixteen years of waking up, studying, testing, failing, and persevering led to this single morning.

As my name was announced over the auditorium loudspeakers and I stepped onto the main stage, I didn't look at the university dean or the thousands of spectators. I scanned the rows until my eyes met yours.
Seeing Mom holding her tissue and Dad standing with his head held high, beaming with unconditional pride—that was my real diploma. This milestone isn't mine alone. It is OUR victory.

letters.title: To My Dearest Mom
letters.subtitle: A Letter of Eternal Gratitude
letterContent: If someone were to count every meal you cooked, every piece of laundry you washed, and every tear you dried, the numbers would reach into infinity. You have spent your entire life giving without ever asking for anything in return.

When college felt overwhelming and I doubted my ability to finish, it was your voice on the phone that calmed my racing heart. You told me you believed in me, even when I struggled to believe in myself.
Today, as I hold this diploma in my hands, I want you to know that half of it belongs to you. Your quiet sacrifices made this day possible. I love you more than words will ever be able to express.
Thank you for being my mother, my protector, and my warmest home.
letters.signature: With all my love and devotion, Your Son

letters.title: To My Hero, My Dad
letters.subtitle: A Letter of Pride and Respect
letterContent: You rarely speak in long speeches, but your actions have spoken louder than a thousand words ever could. I watched you wake up before sunrise, rain or shine, working relentlessly to give our family a secure future.
You taught me what it means to be a man of character—to work hard, speak truthfully, treat people with kindness, and never back down from a challenge.

Dad, when I walked across that graduation stage today, I held my head high because I am your child. Your sacrifices opened doors that were closed to you in your own youth. I promise to spend the rest of my life making you proud of the person you raised.
Thank you for being my hero, my pillar of strength, and my teacher.
letters.signature: With deepest respect and love, Your Son
